one_liner.zh: 用 UI Automation 和窗口消息操作 Windows 桌面，并显示独立 AI 光标。
one_liner.en: Operate the Windows desktop through UI Automation or window messages with a separate AI cursor.

local: Requires Windows PowerShell and Windows desktop APIs; the sidecar uses WinForms and UI Automation when available.
Screenshots are saved to a local path; the default is ~/.dsh/independent-input/shots/.
